description: Key derivation vectors: RFC 5869 HKDF-SHA256, HMAC-SHA256 and the KRRECOV1 recovery subkeys.

hkdf_sha256.description: RFC 5869 appendix A.1, truncated to the 32-byte output this build derives.

name: kdf
note: The recovery seed below is test material. A real seed is 256 random bits from libsodium.

context_binding.description: The key a bundle is actually encrypted under: HKDF-SHA256 over the subkey-1 key, salted with the canonical retrieval context. A bundle served from another origin or under another locator does not authenticate.

recovery.description: libsodium crypto_kdf with context KRRECOV1: subkey 1 is the recovery-bundle key and subkey 2 seeds the recovery recipient's crypto_box keypair.
